rows.name: Crypto perp funding-rate carry (Binance USD-M, incl. delisted)
rows.mechanism: Leveraged (mostly retail) longs pay funding to shorts/basis arbitrageurs; persists because spot-short and exchange/counterparty capital are scarce and levered demand is procyclical
rows.literature: He-Manela-Ross-von Wachter (2022/24) perp-spot deviations large, carry arbitrage Sharpe >1 on majors (approx.); Schmeling-Schrimpf-Todorov (2023 BIS WP) crypto carry >10%/yr on average, predicts crashes (approx.); cross-sectional funding-sort evidence thin/working papers
rows.decay: Basis/funding compressed after 2023 (institutional basis capital, delta-neutral stablecoin products); expect >=50% decay vs 2020-21
rows.data: data.binance.vision fundingRate monthly from 2020-01, 8h timestamps; klines to final settlement; 952 funding symbols archived, 385 not trading now (40%)
rows.prior: never tested (only BTC/ETH TS trend, SPENT)
rows.surv_note: survivor-free archive; live-only list would bias carry IN FAVOUR by ~+17 to +34%/yr (sim T2)
rows.pit_traps: symbol reuse (LUNAUSDT spot = Terra 2.0 after 2022-05), BUSD/USDT duplicates, stock-token perps (AAPLUSDT...), funding interval changes 8h->4h, listing-date selection
rows.impl: Binance.com not open to US persons (verify jurisdiction); taker 5bp; exchange counterparty risk; capacity fine at $100k

rows.name: Crypto leverage crowding: open-interest growth x funding (Binance metrics)
rows.mechanism: Forced deleveraging: crowded levered positions are liquidated into thin books; liquidity providers are paid to absorb
rows.literature: crowding/deleveraging literature (equities: Brunnermeier-Pedersen 2009 funding liquidity); crypto liquidation-cascade studies (working papers)
rows.decay: unknown; mechanism tied to leverage availability
rows.data: futures/um/daily/metrics (OI, long/short ratios) archived from 2020-09
rows.pit_traps: 5-min snapshot timestamps; metrics coverage for small perps starts later

rows.name: Crypto cross-sectional 1-4 week momentum / reversal (same archive)
rows.mechanism: Attention-driven under/over-reaction and liquidity provision among retail-dominated coins
rows.literature: Liu-Tsyvinski-Wu (2022 JF): CMKT/CSIZE/CMOM, 1-4 week momentum (2014-18, CoinMarketCap); Dobrynskaya (2023) momentum then reversal (approx.)
rows.decay: large-coin momentum weaker post-2020 in several replications (approx.)
rows.data: same Binance archive (spot klines 2017+, perps 2020+)
rows.surv_note: survivor-free archive; momentum/reversal loadings on dying coins large (sim SURV_ALL MOMENTUM -39%/yr)
rows.pit_traps: as C1; plus author knows the 2022-25 alt-vs-BTC path (knowledge contamination)

rows.name: US daily short-sale volume (FINRA Reg SHO), 20-day smoothed abnormal ratio, weekly holding
rows.mechanism: Informed short sellers trade ahead of bad news; they are paid by uninformed buyers; persists because shorting is costly/risky
rows.literature: Boehmer-Jones-Zhang (2008 JF): heavily vs lightly shorted -1.16%/20d (NYSE order data 2000-04); Diether-Lee-Werner (2009 RFS, 2005 Reg SHO) ~1.4%/mo gross (approx.); Engelberg-Reed-Ringgenberg (2012 JFE)
rows.decay: FINRA files public since 2009; market-maker shorting (~40-50% of off-exchange volume) dilutes the signal
rows.data: cdn.finra.org regsho daily: per-facility files verified from 2009-08 (FNYX); consolidated CNMS fetchable from 2018-08 (other scout); off-exchange volume only
rows.prior: never tested; not an OSAP predictor
rows.surv_note: bias AGAINST 'high short volume underperforms'; 2018-26 weekly: +0.8 to +2.2%/yr on the high-minus-low spread (sim T1)
rows.pit_traps: file date vs publication time; FINRA symbol conventions (BRK.B); ticker changes; ETFs in files
rows.impl: large caps 2-4bp; weekly turnover ~0.7/leg: costs ~ gross
